# MECHANISM: Penalize bins with small remaining capacity more heavily, but also consider the item size to avoid spreading too much, and use a nonlinear transformation to emphasize large gaps

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    # Penalize bins with small remaining capacity more heavily
    penalty = 1 / bins.clip(min=item)
    # Consider the item size to avoid spreading too much
    size_factor = item / 100.0
    # Use a nonlinear transformation to emphasize large gaps
    gap_transform = np.log1p(bins - item)
    # Combine all factors
